# Ezhill Ragesh

> Software engineer in Chennai, India, working on platforms, developer tooling and applied AI. Software Engineer at Ramco Systems. Researches and files patents on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI security and knowledge graphs. Writes about how software works under the hood. Published name: Ezhill Ragesh K T.

## Work

- Software Engineer, Ramco Systems (2025–present): shared infrastructure for enterprise products, including build and packaging, AI-agent-assisted review workflows, design-token theming, WCAG accessibility and release reliability.
- Software Developer Intern, Minuscule Technologies (2023): health-analytics dashboard using Fitbit and Apple Watch data through Google Fit and HealthKit.

## Research and patents

- System and Method for Human Presence Verified Access Control of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Data. Indian patent application 202641076803, published July 2026, filed through VIT.
- System and Method for Preventing Large Language Model Prompt Injection and Identity Spoofing. Indian patent application 202641022703, filed through VIT.
- CT-KG-RAG: A Threat Knowledge Graph Framework for Graph-Structural Intervention Simulation and Hypothetical Attack-Path Reasoning. Peer-reviewed IEEE conference paper, 2026.
- Clarifying the Role of Non-Linear Models in Financial Markets and Stock Forecasting. Under review.

## Education

- B.Tech, Computer Science and Business Systems, Vellore Institute of Technology (2021–2025).
